annotation.title_clean: 交通运输部 工业和信息化部 国家能源局关于印发《内河新能源船舶推广应用行动方案（2026—2030年）》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and National Energy Administration on Issuing the Action Plan for Promoting New-Energy Inland Waterway Vessels (2026–2030)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 交通运输部; 工业和信息化部; 国家能源局
annotation.summary_en: Chinese national action plan (2026–2030) issued by the transport, industry and energy ministries to promote electric and methanol-powered inland vessels, with targets for 2028 and 2030, charging and bunkering infrastructure, standards, supervision and policy support. It does not address AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: By 2028, new-energy inland vessel fleet doubles vs 2025; over 1000 electric cargo ships and 100 methanol ships
Build 3000 km of zero-carbon waterway corridors on Yangtze, Xijiang, Grand Canal and Yangtze Delta
Develop charging/swapping and methanol bunkering infrastructure and new business models
Improve technical standards, inspection and differentiated safety supervision for new-energy vessels
Financial support, pilot programmes and cross-department coordination for implementation
